svg.title: training: GenRec study diagram
svg.desc: Original study diagram based on the supplied GenRec paper v2. See README for sources, assumptions, and metric baselines.

g.aria-label: GenRec: Phase-2 ranking, from inputs to loss
Text -> contextual vector h. Learned item vectors e_i. Scores -> probabilities -> weighted CE.
Input x and observed target i*
x = user history + request context + selected item details + task.
The target i* comes from valuable observed engagement; it is supervision, not an input to the scoring head.
02 THE RANKING HEAD TAKES h AND e_i
Encode x; pool a hidden state h
s_i = phi(h, e_i) for each item
One shared h; many item vectors
03 COMPARE WITH THE TARGET, THEN WEIGHT THE LOSS
L = alpha * L_ranking + beta * L_language + gamma * L_misc
L_ranking conceptually averages: w_j * CE(target item, predicted catalog distribution)
Update LLM weights, ranking-head parameters, and item embeddings e_i together.
h is an activation, not a separately stored user-vector parameter.
Serving uses scores, not the training loss
Use the ranking path; sort item scores to return Top-K.
Softmax preserves score order. No sequential decoding.
LM loss, targets, and reward weights are training signals.
CE can consume logits directly via a stable log-softmax.
The toy example illustrates single-target CE.
The paper does not disclose its exact reward-weight mapping.
Source: GenRec v2, sections 4.2-4.7. Toy values and expanded weighted CE are explanatory; phi need not be a dot product.
